subject.title: ACP parent session stuck until refresh when yielded waiting for child completion

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for a durable yielded-parent completion contract, or should maintainers split/close it after the current targeted fixes and route each remaining wake failure to narrower issues?
rationale: Current main has meaningful partial repairs, but the remaining failures span ACP task terminal delivery, native announce delivery, top-level fan-out synthesis, and invalid `sessions_yield` usage; choosing the canonical contract and PR sequence is a maintainer product/architecture decision.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Review Slices
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers land or reject the narrower candidate PRs and use this thread to track the shared yielded-parent wake contract.

options.title: Split To Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Close or supersede this issue only after assigning each remaining failure mode to a specific open canonical issue with preserved reproduction evidence.

options.title: Sponsor Phase B Yield State
options.body: Use this issue to drive an explicit persisted yield-wait lifecycle implementation instead of continuing one-off wake-path repairs.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Review Slices
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers land or reject the narrower candidate PRs and use this thread to track the shared yielded-parent wake contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision crosses task lifecycle and parent-session delivery semantics introduced through the background task lifecycle work, while still requiring coordination with the ACP and subagent delivery owners.
